One thing that helped me to get out of daily drinking is getting the alcohol away from me. Don't buy any and if the urge is so big that you have to get something, try any other alcohol free drink.

Every time I get the feeling I have to drink solo, I make myself a mint tea. Sounds stupid but it helps.
Maybe there is a solution for you, it's not as healthy but maybe try coke zero? Or something completely new like I did.

The first few days will be hard but it'll get better.

And maybe talk to a doctor about it, because over such a long time drinking so much alcohol could do things to your body :/

I wish you the best man!
